// ServiceAuth: Shared secret for service-to-service calls to Content's internal endpoints (moderation-visibility, title lookup). Empty on purpose: provide via env ServiceAuth__Token outside local dev. When empty, only a valid JWT is accepted.
// Services: Downstream service endpoints. *.ServiceToken must match that service's ServiceAuth:Token. Provide via env (Services__NotificationApi__BaseUrl / __ServiceToken, Services__AuthApi__BaseUrl / __ServiceToken) outside local dev.
// ChapterPublishing: Background loop that publishes Scheduled chapters when their ScheduledAt passes. Enabled by default; set Enabled=false to turn it off for an instance.
// Elasticsearch: Story search index. Enabled=false (default) makes the whole feature inert -- the background sync job no-ops, reads fall back to the Postgres ILIKE path. SearchReadEnabled only matters once Enabled is also true; kept separate so the sync job can backfill the index before reads cut over.
// StorySearchSync: Background loop that scans Postgres for stories/chapters changed since the last run and pushes them into Elasticsearch. Fully decoupled from the write-path handlers -- this loop is the only writer to the search index. Runs regardless of Elasticsearch:Enabled (a no-op write when disabled), so it's cheap to leave on.
// Redis: View tracking buffer + daily view statistics. Enabled=false (default) makes every view a direct Postgres increment exactly as before and never opens a Redis connection. Provide ConnectionString via env (Redis__ConnectionString) outside local dev.
// ViewCountFlush: Background loop that adds the view counts buffered in Redis to the Postgres ViewCount columns in batches. A no-op while Redis is disabled.

AuthSettings.// SecretKey: Placeholder only. Never commit a real signing key here. Provide it via environment variable (e.g. GcpSettings__AuthSettings__SecretKey) or GCP Secret Manager, per auth-guidelines.md section 12.
